messages:
Maya R: hey all :wave: i'm in my first week and trying to make a copy of the infra runbook template in Notion so i can adapt it for our service. i can open the page but hitting Duplicate errors with "permission denied". any quick fixes?
Sam G: welcome Maya! :tada: templates are under Notion > Workspaces > Engineering > Playbooks. infra-runbook-template is read-only by default. link: https://notion.redwood.company/s/infra-runbook-template
Maya R: thanks — when i try to duplicate it asks me to pick a workspace then fails. do i need a special docs role or an okta group?
Jess L: you need to be in the `engineering-editors` docs group. easiest route: run "/request-docs-access engineering-editors" (Devex Bot will kick off the approval). include your manager in the request if you want faster approve.
Maya R: do i request access to the page or the group?
Jess L: request the group. once you're in the group you can duplicate and publish copies under your personal space. our convention: personal drafts live at /People/<your-name>/ then move to Engineering/Team Pages when ready.
Devex Bot: Access request created: "/request-docs-access engineering-editors" from Maya R at 1865440015. Expect ~10-30m for approvals. To expedite, DM @jess.l or @alex.t.
Alex T: small tips — when you duplicate a runbook: rename it `service-runbook-YYYYMM`, add tags `#runbook #infra`, and put a 1-line summary + owner table at the top so search and ownership show up.
Maya R: great, that helps. also noticed two onboarding checklists (Starter Kit vs Onboarding - old). which is the canonical one?
Jess L: canonical is Engineering > Onboarding > Starter Kits. the other one is legacy and should be archived. please comment on that page `@docs-admins please archive` and we'll handle archiving and redirection.
Sam G: also, infra-specific templates (cronjobs, incident steps) are in Playbooks too — search for "cron-ops" or filter by tag `#infra`. happy to DM direct links.
Alex T: one more process note — if you edit a shared playbook, add a changelog block at the bottom with date + initials and set the page to 'Published' once it's stable. if unsure, use Suggest Edits and ping Docs.
Maya R: awesome, i submitted the access request and renamed my draft. last q: who can add a page to the team nav?
Jess L: Docs Admins manage nav entries. once published, ping `@docs-admins` with the page link and a one-line description and we'll add it. if urgent, pin the draft in the channel until it's added.
Maya R: perfect — thanks everyone for the quick help :pray:
